reviewer.method: Inline independent source review using ck:quality and code-review; no implementation delegation.

scope.boundaries: All 17 Phase06 declared outputs; supporting API/backend contracts and existing UI conventions read-only. Unrelated exam changes excluded. No production/test edits, no tests or browser execution.

evaluations.area: Independent bounded paging and full totals
evaluations.assessment: Each visible work bucket owns page state and sends its own bounded size=5 request; UNAVAILABLE has a separate request/page. Table size=20 uses the same server projection. Column summary uses totalByStatus rather than page length for official totals; page length is explicitly the number shown. Backend totals are accumulated before workStatus selection and pagination; no local grouping/aggregation substitutes for full totals.

Applied date/session/publication filters are shared between board and table; immediate work-status selection changes visible request-backed columns/table server predicate. Successful Apply and Clear increment revision and remount the board/table, resetting all pages even for identical predicates. Clear also resets work status to ALL. The route keys the entire view by selected publicId; examiner components mount only for EXAMINER and requests are enabled only for an active tab and a valid Host tenant/target scope. Query keys include tenant, target and predicates; AbortSignal is forwarded.

evaluations.area: Progress, units, zero-work and unavailable coverage
evaluations.assessment: Session counts, assignment/attempt counts and eligible/submitted answer counts remain separately labeled. Overview uses server totals and coverage flag; partial verified counts are explicitly separate, never presented as whole-workload completion. Null/invalid progress renders unavailable without a bar; consistent eligible=0 renders no-work copy instead of a fabricated graded percentage. An empty overview renders no assignments. Percentages outside 0..100 are not rendered. Session-level unavailable progress is not counted as completed.

Publication uses the backend publication field independently of work completion; published history is not excluded by default. Cards and table expose only Host session-detail navigation, not scoring commands, allocation/confirmation or impersonation. UI renders metadata and aggregate counts only, not answer payloads, individual scores or raw diagnostic errors.

Board/BoardColumn are small presentation-only slot compositions of stock DashboardCard/CollapsibleSection. Domain status, query, projection and paging stay in the feature. Layout classes do not override shipped typography, colors, sizing or action triggers. Existing common controls provide keyboard interactions; feature copy uses the shared locale catalog. Components are focused and below documented line limits.

evaluations.area: Error isolation, refresh and schedule semantics
evaluations.assessment: Each request has its own loading/error/retry branch and explicit manual refresh; a failed column does not zero other columns. No added polling. Both display modes use deterministic schedule sort descending plus server publicId tie-breaker and the same validated base filters. Date-only filters use approved Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh inclusive day boundaries converted to UTC; nullable schedules display unscheduled and backend date predicates exclude missing schedules.

performed_by_reviewer.note: Tracked paths only; feature sources are currently untracked and were inspected directly. Git emitted only an LF/CRLF informational warning.
